hypotheses.falsifier: On a prospective held-out batch, if P080's incremental_rank_correlation computed after removing overall-cloud similarity falls below zero while the full-pose final_affinity_rank_correlation remains high, then the apparent P080 advantage is attributable to overall pose similarity rather than region-specific organization.
